incidents.title: Latifa bint Mohammed: My grandmother, Sheikha Latifa bint Hamdan bin Zayed Al Nahyan, was a woman who made her mark quietly, placing people at the heart of every action. Through the stories shared within our family, I came to know her as a woman who was close to people and present in the details of their lives. She saw serving the community as a responsibility that needed no spotlight, and empowering women and families as a path toward building a stronger society. In a British document, I read how others saw her, and how her contributions extended to education, healthcare, and supporting those in need, reaffirming that true impact does not always need to announce itself; it is enough for it

Our children are our true wealth, and I encourage them to embark on the new school year with optimism, ambition, and determination, making the most of every opportunity to gain knowledge and life skills. I also encourage continued cooperation between families and schools to foster a passion for lifelong learning, equip students with the skills of the future, and reinforce a strong sense of identity and values.
